description: May 24 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 24 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: The May 24 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Gemini's chatter turns caring on the 24th of May. With the Sun three degrees into the Twins and the birthday number 6, the airy sign's interest in people becomes an interest in looking after them. Traditional readings describe the friend who checks in by message every week, the parent who explains everything, the neighbour who knows who needs a lift.

Astronomically, May 24 puts the Sun near 3° Gemini in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 24
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 24 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 24 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 24 is the 144th day of the year (145th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 29 days, by June 22.

By May 24 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 24 birthday are Bob Dylan (1941), Victoria (1819) and Joseph Brodsky (1940).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 24?
faq.answer: May 24 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 24 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 24?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 24?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 24 include Bob Dylan (1941), Victoria (1819) and Joseph Brodsky (1940). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
